prompt:
A wide establishing vista of Rio de Janeiro in a far-future cyberpunk world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: Rio de Janeiro two centuries from now, a far-future megacity between rainforest mountains and the sea: the rounded granite peaks of the bay kept exactly as they stand, each ringed by a slow halo of light, transparent gondolas gliding between them on threads of light; slender towers of white ceramic and glass rising from the green hills in curving terraces overflowing with rainforest gardens; on the highest peak the colossal open-armed statue kept exactly as it stands in a soft glow; the long crescent beach traced by its black-and-white wave promenade rebuilt in rippling light; a vast parade avenue of light where floats of light glide and drummers march; quiet flying vehicles in lanes over the turquoise bay under a clear night sky.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
